q: What was total revenue in March 2026?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions WHERE type='income' AND substr(date,1,7)='2026-03'

q: Which month had the highest sales?
sql: SELECT substr(date,1,7) m FROM transactions WHERE type='income' GROUP BY m ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What were total expenses over the whole year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions WHERE type='expense'

q: How much did we pay Kerman Nuts Ltd. in total?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions WHERE vendor='Kerman Nuts Ltd.'

q: What was our total profit for the year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN type='income' THEN amount ELSE -amount END),2) FROM transactions

q: Which expense category was the biggest?
sql: SELECT category FROM transactions WHERE type='expense' GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How much did we spend on utilities in January 2026?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions WHERE category='Utilities' AND substr(date,1,7)='2026-01'

q: In which months did we lose money?
sql: SELECT m FROM (SELECT substr(date,1,7) m, SUM(CASE WHEN type='income' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) p FROM transactions GROUP BY m) WHERE p < 0 ORDER BY m

q: How much did we spend on refrigeration repairs?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions WHERE category='Repairs'

q: When did we start paying for CloudBackup Pro?
sql: SELECT MIN(date) FROM transactions WHERE vendor='CloudBackup Pro'
